controlsObservation: Each option has a distinct native 16x16 radio or checkbox before its letter. Single-mode q1-3,q5-17,q19-20 use radios; multiple-mode q4 and q18 use checkboxes. Controls and letters remain aligned with readable first lines, including multiline options and tables, without obscuring text.
limitations: This is an offline headless display review, not headed product acceptance, DB readback, or a product functionality claim.
No selecting, judging, persistence, answer correctness, accessibility behavior, or other shared app functionality was tested.
Mathematics, source fidelity, figures' mathematical correctness, and option semantics remain the already-passed reviews supplied by the human; this observer did not resolve or re-review them.
Expected content was exclusively the hash-bound view-only projection. No answer-key file was opened, and no key, draft intent, or coverage entered model context or rendered page.
Only source-asset identities/bytes and display metadata were used for the exact reconstruction; original scans, standards, authors and other reviewers were not consulted.
No canonical/shared/app files were changed. No DB, environment, paid service, install, network freshness, Git, agents, messages, or scheduled activity was used.
